source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板の改修用。ユーザーが別に生成した 1254x1254 の画像。1 枚の絵のマスは crop で余白 (白い背景や壁) を切り落とす
style: Front views of home furniture and appliances for a space-habitat apartment. Each cell is ONE object seen exactly straight on, filling the cell edge to edge, flat even light, no background, no shadows, no readable text.
